interface.name: rin_window_view_manager_v1
interface.description:
A privileged client shows other clients' toplevel windows inside one of its own surfaces. The compositor draws each window's current content itself, so a view is as live as the window and costs no copy.
Views are drawn directly above the surface they belong to, including its subsurfaces, in ascending order. A view of negative order is drawn beneath the surface instead, over what the compositor draws behind it (its background effect): the client's own content covers it, so the client leaves the pixels where the window shows transparent and draws over them what goes over the window. Views take no input.

request.name: get_window_view

description.summary: show a window inside a surface

request.description:
Creates a view of the toplevel whose ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier is window, inside a surface that is not a subsurface. A view of a window that does not exist, or no longer exists, shows nothing.
The view shows nothing until a destination has been committed.

interface.name: rin_window_view_v1

description.summary: one live window inside a surface

interface.description:
Every state below is double-buffered and applied on the next commit of the surface the view belongs to, together with that surface's content.
When the surface is destroyed, the view becomes inert.

entry.name: invalid_destination
entry.summary: the destination is not larger than zero

entry.name: invalid_clip
entry.summary: the clip has a negative size or radius

request.name: destroy
request.description: The view disappears with the next commit of its surface.

request.name: set_destination
request.description: The window's geometry, as set by xdg_surface.set_window_geometry or its X11 frame, is scaled into this rectangle, in the surface's logical coordinates. Nothing outside the geometry is shown.

request.name: set_clip

description.summary: the rounded rectangle the view stays inside

request.description: In the surface's logical coordinates, with one radius per corner. A clip with zero width and zero height removes it.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: From 0 to 1. The initial opacity is 1.

request.name: set_order

description.summary: where the view stands among its siblings

request.description: Views of one surface are drawn in ascending order; views of equal order in the order they were created. A negative order puts the view beneath the surface. The initial order is 0.
